Ys.bar_b_note: Neon camouflage blotches swallow the face and form so the frog reads as noise, not a Palworld-class creature, and it stands no taller than the trainer.

Wb.bar_b_note: A strong coiled serpent silhouette with cyan/pink fins and a clear head carries it; only the bare neutral stage lacks any Valheim-class light.

Rn.bar_b_note: Dark navy body on a dark backdrop, a thin spindly build and faint poses that barely change from standing sink the read.

My.bar_b_note: A grounded, naturalistic furred bear with mossy shell plates, a clear face and a believable ridden scale is on the owner's style bar.

Pc.bar_b_note: A murky olive-on-grey value range, a face lost in the spines and an odd wheel-like belly shape in faint end sink it.

Gt.bar_b_note: The barnacled crab reads well, but faint mid and faint end are nearly identical to standing, so the faint never reads.

Qk.bar_b_note: A distinctive mossy kirin silhouette, let down by a contorted, broken-looking neck curl in faint mid and a tiny rider in the ridden frame.

Tu.bar_b_note: An appealing teal otter mount with a clear face, a pale bib and good ridden scale reads as a Palworld-class creature.

Wz.bar_b_note: The moth wings read, but it barely clears the trainer and stays upright through faint mid and faint end, so hurt and faint never read.

Rm.bar_b_note: A low salamander no taller than the trainer, whose pale crest vanishes in the faint frames and leaves a stray thin spike at the tail.

Cu.bar_b_note: A warm, readable grandfather villager with expressive eyes and a green/olive earthy palette fits the cozy Meadows settlement.

Ng.bar_b_note: Neither boar clears the trainer: A has naturalistic fur but noisy yellow blotches and floats in faint mid, while B looks like smooth glazed clay, below the naturalistic bar.

Ni.bar_b_note: A's large ingredient text and labelled Craft/Leave hints help, but the panel has no teal or gold accents and its list clips the third recipe; B's tiny truncated text and grey 'Craft: A / Enter' hints fail at a glance.

Up.bar_b_note: A naturalistic moss-backed hare with tall ears, a clear head and grounded faint poses matches the owner's style bar.

To.bar_b_note: A's timber frame, brace, cap and stone footing read as built, but it still stands as a lone thin panel; B is a blown-out white card, and the flat world around both is far below Palworld density and Valheim light.

top_changes.change: Author real hurt/faint motion so creatures visibly collapse and stay grounded (Gt, Wz, Rn barely change; Ng A floats in faint mid; Qk neck contorts)
Scale every creature above the 1.80 m trainer (Ys, Rm, Ng and Wz currently match or barely clear him)
Material and value pass on noisy or murky creatures (Ys neon camo, Pc olive murk, Rn navy on dark, Ng B glazed clay) with rim light and a readable face
